reason: New test-only function; it adds coverage and cannot change production behavior.
headline: New test: CompactSelectedSeries skips series holding out-of-order data
summary: Adds a test that appends in-order samples to two series, one OOO sample to one of them, then calls CompactSelectedSeries on both and asserts one series remains in the head, one selected-series block is written, and the triggered/failed metrics are 1/0. It is test-only, so it needs no line-by-line review, though its assertions are weaker than its doc comment says.

issues.title: Test doesn't check which series stayed or any SkippedOOO counter
issues.evidence:
// and not evicted from the head, and the SkippedOOO counter is incremented. ...
require.Equal(t, uint64(1), db.Head().NumSeries())
issues.failure_scenario: Suppose a regression evicts the OOO series and keeps the in-order one, or skips the wrong ref. NumSeries is still 1 and one block is still written, so the test passes. No SkippedOOO counter is asserted; CompactSelectedSeries only logs num_skipped_ooo.
issues.detail: The doc comment says the test checks that the OOO series is kept and that a SkippedOOO counter goes up. The code only checks series counts and the triggered/failed metrics, so it would not catch the regression it was written for.
